description: Request cancellation of a queued (not-yet-started) request. Returns 202 { status: 'CANCELLATION_REQUESTED' }. fal.ai queue: PUT {queue}/{model_id}/requests/{request_id}/cancel.

model_id.description: The fal.ai model id, used raw as a path segment, e.g. 'fal-ai/flux/schnell'.

request_id.description: The queue request id returned when the request was submitted.

name: falai_cancel_request
title: Cancel request
